request.note: No payload. The handler reads no field.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: You have a character. The array has every online character that is not in a PvP area (`is_in_pvp`), in no fixed order.
responses.note: `pets` also replies on the `players` event, with an array of pet records. Tell the two replies apart by the request that you sent.

responses.name: Success on a PvP server
responses.when: On a PvP server (`is_pvp`): every online character, with the name and the map hidden.

confirm.note: `kills` is absent when the character has no `kills` value

responses.note: `pets` also replies on the `players` event, with an array of pet records. Tell the two replies apart by the request that you sent.
